structure_statistic.code:
def stat(d):
    X = np.asarray(d["X"], dtype=float)
    S, T, F = X.shape
    m = X.mean(axis=1)
    w = ((X - m[:, None, :]) ** 2).sum(axis=(0, 1)) / (S * (T - 1))
    b = m.var(axis=0, ddof=1) - w / T
    tot = b + w
    icc = b / np.where(tot > 0, tot, 1.0)
    return float(np.mean(icc))
